phase: Prompt comparison on the repaired meal baseline. Every earlier comparison ran where 77 percent of all purchases were one forced online detergent; here the baseline buys groceries, orders in and eats, and the distance to each citizen own assigned mix is 0.53 instead of 0.80.
primary: The seventeen answer-key indicators, scored with the block bootstrap. Secondary: composition distance to each citizen own assigned mix, and the gate-blocked count before repair.
limitations: One seed per arm. The block bootstrap needs several blocks, so intervals here are the cell bootstrap and will be too narrow; the verdict is read as a bound, not a decision.
Gate-blocked cells are repaired by the loop and the matrix stays incomplete by construction.
v34 is v30 and v33 stacked; both were individually neutral or better and neither names a policy, sector, direction or number.
Reaching a better composition is not the same as matching a published effect.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair fixed before the run (experiments/v16/prompt_v16.md).
